hostname.description: Fully-qualified domain name (FQDN) of this server; must match SSL certificate and DNS.

network_name.description: Network name displayed in client whois and network lists.

network_description.default: A friendly IRC network for community discussion.
network_description.description: Short human-readable description of the network.

listeners.description: List of socket listeners for client/server connections.

max_connections_per_ip.description: Maximum concurrent connections allowed per client IP address.

max_messages_per_second.description: Rate limit: maximum messages per client per second before throttling.

ssl_verify.description: Require and verify SSL certificates for server-to-server links.

sasl_backend.description: Backend for SASL authentication: 'external' (TLS client certs), 'memory' (in-memory), or 'sql' (database-backed).

sql_driver.description: Database driver (e.g., 'sqlite3', 'postgres'). Only used if sasl_backend='sql'.

sql_dsn.description: Data source name (connection string or file path) for SQL backend.

tls_min_version.description: Minimum TLS version for server-to-server and client TLS (1.2 recommended).

tls_ciphers.description: List of allowed TLS cipher suites (in order of preference).

tls_prefer_server_ciphers.description: Prefer server cipher order over client order during TLS negotiation.

log_level.description: Verbosity of server logs (debug includes full protocol traffic).

log_file.description: Path to log file. If empty or null, logs go to stderr.

links.description: List of upstream servers (for federated IRC networks).

server_description.description: Server description sent to clients and upstream servers.

server_sid.description: Server ID (3-digit hex string, unique across all servers in the network).

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity after which a client is automatically disconnected.
